concept.hr: Kapacitet kanala iz širine pojasa i omjera signal-šum
concept.en: Channel capacity from bandwidth and signal-to-noise ratio

summary.hr: C = B · log₂(1 + S/N): uz 0 dB kapacitet je jednak širini pojasa. Dvostruki B daje dvostruki C, dvostruka snaga najviše bit po hercu više.
summary.en: C = B · log₂(1 + S/N): at 0 dB the capacity equals the bandwidth. Twice B gives twice C; twice the power, at most one more bit per hertz.

what.hr: Tekst odjeljka o Shannon-Hartleyevu zakonu (50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod): formula, pravilo 0 dB, FT8/WSPR, HAMNET, referentni pojas, gornja granica
what.en: The text of the Shannon–Hartley section (50ohm.de, Croatian translation): the formula, the 0 dB rule, FT8/WSPR, HAMNET, the reference bandwidth, the upper bound

changes.hr: Odjeljak sažet u objašnjenje i preveden na engleski; dodani pravokutnik B × log₂(1 + S/N), krivulja C/B, ciljna brzina i primjeri sustava; ništa nije preuzeto doslovno
changes.en: The section summarised into the explanation and translated into English; the rectangle B × log₂(1 + S/N), the C/B curve, the target rate and the example systems added; nothing is copied verbatim
